messages.settings-introduction: Configure Observatory's private local sources, accessible presentation, and bounded background-work behaviour.
messages.settings-recorder-priority-detail: These preferences change how patiently and quickly resumable maintenance runs. They cannot weaken evidence checks, database limits, or recorder priority.
messages.settings-rebuild-confirm-detail: Observations, branches, interpretations, settings, and save files remain unchanged. DuckDB-derived analytics are cleared first and then recreated from SQLite's authoritative outbox; large histories may be temporarily unavailable.
messages.settings-cache-detail: Storage contract v{ $contract }. The latest run retried { $retries } times and waited about { $seconds } seconds for local storage.
messages.legal-readonly-contract-detail: The reviewed probe reads bounded fields from already loaded game memory and writes only its fixed telemetry file. Its allowlisted readiness record contains a stage, never addresses or rejected values. The host may ingest a validated resource-registry record after explicit consent. The probe cannot write simulation state, saves, Observatory databases, or network resources.
messages.legal-research-evidence-detail: Person vector positions and sampled fields remain ephemeral. They are not imported into SQLite or DuckDB and do not establish stable identity, family links, causality, or longitudinal history.
messages.population-probe-description: A bounded companion can expose candidate live fields that saves do not yet reveal. The Observatory validates a fixed telemetry file and reports only aggregate probe status here.
messages.population-probe-read-only-detail: One chained observation hook reads loaded fields after the game renders a frame. The separate observation-only loader configuration must also be verified before launch.
messages.population-probe-ephemeral-detail: Person sample records are not imported into SQLite or DuckDB. Validated resource-registry snapshots use a separate opt-in storage contract.
messages.resources-live-detail: The host may persist one validated, content-addressed resource-registry snapshot from the optional Tesmio probe. Offline catalogue discovery remains authoritative.
messages.resources-live-boundary-detail: A live registry snapshot is session evidence. It never replaces save-backed price history or becomes a historical observation after restart.
messages.population-probe-missing-detail: The companion remains entirely optional. Ordinary save observation and aggregate Population analytics continue without it.
messages.settings-background-priority-detail: Choose how often maintenance yields between bounded chunks.
messages.settings-rebuild-queued: The analytical warehouse rebuild was queued. Save recording remains available while derived views catch up.
messages.settings-rebuild-error: The analytical warehouse rebuild could not be queued. Existing evidence and save files remain unchanged.
messages.theme-help-text: Theme files contain named colour roles and a bounded chart palette. They cannot contain CSS, scripts, fonts, images, paths, URLs, layouts, or renderer settings.
messages.theme-preview-text: Muted explanatory text remains legible on every host-owned surface.
messages.theme-install-contrast-blocked: This structurally valid draft does not pass the native contrast assay. It can still be exported for further work, but it cannot be installed.
messages.theme-error-insufficient-contrast: The native contrast assay blocked this theme from installation.
messages.recovery-retained-evidence-safety: Observations, analytical history, selected branches, and save archives remain unchanged. Observatory only verifies its own known storage contracts and requeues derived analytical projections.
messages.diagnostics-introduction: A bounded English record of important local operations and failures. It is never uploaded automatically.
messages.markets-evidence-banner-detail: Every value stops at the exact analytical head. Reinterpreted variants remain grouped with the same immutable save moment.
messages.markets-commissioning-boundary-detail: Indexing creates a new interpretation under the current parser while preserving every earlier value and branch membership. It never moves the selected analytical head.
messages.markets-index-failed-detail: The current archive stopped safely. Existing observations and the selected analytical head were not changed.
messages.markets-action-warehouse-unavailable: The derived analytical warehouse could not be reached. SQLite evidence remains authoritative and unchanged. A guided rebuild is available.
messages.markets-recovery-contract-message: Observatory can verify its known app-local storage contracts, queue derived warehouse projections again, and then resume guided Markets indexing.
messages.markets-no-evidence: No market interpretation at this head
messages.markets-empty-detail: Ordinary save observation remains valid. Run guided indexing to reinterpret only archives that exactly match an existing recorded observation.
messages.markets-partial-detail: The receiver and population observation remains valid. One or more market blocks could not be mapped safely and were omitted with diagnostics.
messages.markets-warehouse-lag-title: Historical market models are waiting for the warehouse
messages.markets-warehouse-lag-detail: Exact selected-head SQLite ledgers remain available. Large historical models resume after governed DuckDB projection succeeds.
messages.markets-channel-unobserved-detail: No { $currency } { $channel } trade rows exist at this analytical head. Blank readings mean unavailable evidence, not a zero-valued market.
messages.markets-context-description: This source-backed definition follows the value into cards, charts, and accessible ledgers.
messages.markets-context-exclusion-denominator: A compatible denominator is required for a derived yield or coverage ratio
messages.markets-time-selected-window: Exact selected analytical head; source-recorded window
messages.markets-time-proven-history: Proven history through the exact selected analytical head
messages.markets-time-city-snapshot: Exact city snapshot at the selected analytical head
messages.markets-concentration-chart-description: Standard-channel export account values above zero only. Negative disposal entries remain in the ledger.
messages.markets-price-history-chart-description: Recorded purchase, sell, and base prices through the exact analytical head. Missing records remain gaps and no annualisation or interpolation is applied.
messages.markets-price-history-loading-detail: Only the selected resource is being read from the analytical warehouse.
messages.markets-price-history-unavailable-detail: The selected-head price ledger remains exact. Historical lines appear after its governed warehouse projection is current.
messages.markets-account-ledger-detail: Source values are displayed exactly. Yield and debt-service coverage remain gated without a proven denominator or named player scenario.
messages.markets-account-ledger-empty: No supported scalar account fields were recorded at this analytical head.
messages.markets-basket-saved: The immutable basket revision was saved and selected.
messages.markets-scenario-saved: The immutable scenario revision was saved and selected.
messages.markets-remove-confirm: Remove this inactive local definition from the active list? Its immutable revisions remain retained for provenance.
messages.archive-historical-preview-detail: Every workspace is pinned to this exact immutable save. Later states remain intact but are excluded.
messages.archive-continuation-confirm: Create a new continuation from this save? Later history will remain intact on its existing branch.
messages.archive-context-action-failed: The analytical context could not be changed. No observation was altered.
messages.archive-branch-safety-note: Branches preserve mutually exclusive histories. Selecting one changes analytical context; it never rewrites or deletes another branch.
messages.archive-evidence-explanation: Branching uses supported record identity and exact prefixes—not filenames or file modification order.
messages.archive-heading-description: Inspect every distinct supported state, see when repeated files were deduplicated, and choose the branch used by analytical workspaces.
messages.archive-unresolved-description: Histories withheld from a branch because the supported evidence cannot resolve them safely.
messages.archive-rule-successor: An exact prior history prefix continues a branch.
messages.archive-rule-fork: A rollback or incompatible successor starts a separate branch.
messages.archive-comparison-needs-two: Observe at least two distinct states on this branch before calculating a change.
messages.observer-settings-owned-detail: This window remains focused on observation status, compatibility, manual inspection, and evidence. Folder and automatic-watching preferences have one application-wide owner.
messages.observer-save-folder-detail: Choose the folder containing the game's ZIP saves. Manual observation opens the newest candidate; automatic observation baselines older files, then queues each new candidate. Neither modifies a save.
messages.observer-automatic-detail: While the desktop program is open, native file events wake the Rust recorder and periodic reconciliation protects against missed events. It waits for an unchanged file window and retries temporary incomplete saves without disturbing earlier observations.
messages.observer-automatic-needs-folder: Choose a save folder before automatic observation can begin.
messages.error-observer-storage-unavailable: The private local observation database is unavailable.
messages.error-observer-storage-busy: The private local observation database is temporarily busy. Wait for the current critical task to finish, then retry.
messages.error-observer-unknown-branch: That timeline branch is no longer available. Refresh the archive and choose another branch.
messages.error-observer-incompatible-comparison: Those observations are not on one resolved branch and cannot be combined into a change.
messages.error-observer-unknown-observation: One of those observations is no longer available. Refresh the archive and choose again.
messages.monitor-near-live-detail: Native file events wake the recorder; a periodic reconciliation pass protects against missed operating-system notifications.
messages.monitor-desktop-required-detail: Launch the desktop program to watch a local save folder and retain its recording ledger in SQLite.
messages.monitor-recorder-native: Rust-owned service; independent of the displayed workspace.
messages.monitor-no-core-blocking: Earlier observations and other workspaces remain available.
messages.monitor-service-description: A native folder event requests a scan. The recorder then verifies a stable identity, reads the archive in place, and commits the result and its provenance locally.
messages.monitor-pulse-description: Movement and observation cadence for the selected resolved timeline. Values remain tied to completed saves and actual in-game dates.
messages.monitor-comparison-unavailable: The two latest selected-branch observations could not be compared safely.
messages.monitor-classified-note: The denominator is the four supported receiver classes, not total population.
messages.monitor-unverified-statistics-note: Current and city scalar facts are retained faithfully, but demographic fields are not shown as rates until their accumulation window and denominator are verified.
messages.monitor-chart-cadence-description: Elapsed in-game days between consecutive retained states on the selected branch. This measures observation spacing, not desktop wall-clock polling.
messages.monitor-chart-receiver-change-descriptio: Signed citizen-count change between the two latest distinct states on the selected resolved branch.
messages.monitor-ledger-empty: No save candidate has entered the ledger
messages.monitor-ledger-empty-detail: Enable automatic observation after choosing a save folder. Existing older files are baselined rather than silently replayed.
messages.monitor-candidate-safe-detail: The ledger records bounded file identity and processing evidence without exposing the configured folder path.
messages.security-language-storage-native: Desktop authority: validated by Rust and stored in the app-local SQLite database.
messages.security-language-storage-preview: Browser preview: stored only in this browser profile. The desktop application uses Rust and SQLite instead.
messages.synthetic-briefing-sidebar-note: This interface uses synthetic values. Connected observations will retain source, coverage, parser version, and actual game date.
messages.material-note-fuel: Exposure fell across the recent observation window.
messages.briefing-evidence-sidebar-note: Every displayed value is tied to the exact analytical head. Missing facts remain unavailable, and later saves are excluded from historical previews.
messages.briefing-save-evidence-detail: Counts are read from the selected immutable observation; changes use only its proven preceding observation on the same branch.
messages.briefing-chart-change-description: Differences between the selected save and its proven preceding observation. Empty categories mean no comparable source fact was available.
messages.briefing-chart-education-description: All recorded citizens in the exact selected save, not the game's workers-only education panel. Categories are not converted into shares without a validated common denominator.
messages.briefing-capability-plan-detail: No versioned player plan and target series is connected to the selected branch, so attainment and schedule variance are unavailable.
messages.metric-context-help-text: This host-owned definition follows the metric into cards, charts, and evidence inspection.
messages.metric-context-time-history: Proven observations on the selected branch through the exact analytical head
messages.metric-context-comparison-preceding: Only the proven preceding observation on the same branch and compatibility profile
messages.metric-context-comparison-plan: The immutable player-plan schedule on this branch and revision
messages.metric-context-limitation-window: The source counter's accumulation window and rate denominator are not yet verified
messages.plan-sidebar-boundary: Plans record player intent. Observations remain immutable save facts; schedules, deviations, guardrails, and attainment are deterministic calculations.
messages.plan-evidence-banner-detail: Every plan is anchored to one exact save and follows only proven observations on that branch through the selected analytical head.
messages.plan-heading-description: Set a bounded programme against recorded republic metrics, then compare actual observations with an immutable schedule without rewriting history.
messages.plan-desktop-required-detail: Plan revisions and branch selection are owned by the local SQLite host. The browser preview cannot persist them.
messages.plan-no-observation-detail: The exact selected observation supplies the immutable baseline and branch identity for a new plan.
messages.plan-empty-detail: Create or select a saved plan to compare its schedule with branch observations.
messages.plan-editor-description: The host validates every baseline, direction, deadline, target, and guardrail before it records a new immutable revision.
messages.plan-direction-derived: Calculated from the immutable baseline and target value.
messages.plan-revisions-description: Selecting or rolling back changes the active planning context; it never deletes the revision history or alters save observations.
messages.plan-remove-confirm: Remove this plan from the active branch? Its immutable revisions remain retained in local storage.
messages.plan-revision-summary: Active r{ $active } · latest r{ $latest } · { $count } immutable revisions
messages.plan-no-saved-title: No saved plans on this branch
messages.plan-no-saved-detail: A new plan will be anchored to the exact selected observation.
messages.plan-inspector-detail: This reading combines an immutable player target with exact same-branch observations and a host-owned deterministic schedule.
messages.plan-notification-created: The plan was validated, recorded, and selected for this branch.
messages.plan-notification-revised: A new immutable plan revision was recorded and selected.
messages.plan-error-direction-mismatch: A target direction conflicts with its immutable baseline. Adjust the target value; direction is calculated automatically.
messages.plan-error-window: The plan must end after its starting observation and no more than 100 game years later.
messages.plan-error-metric-unavailable: One selected metric is unavailable at the plan's immutable starting observation.
messages.plan-error-unknown-plan: That saved plan or revision is no longer available on this branch.
messages.plan-error-branch-mismatch: That plan belongs to another timeline branch. Select its branch before changing it.
messages.plan-error-save: The plan action could not be completed. No plan observation or earlier revision was changed.
messages.plan-chart-description: Exact branch observations compared with the active immutable player-plan schedule through the selected analytical head.
messages.plan-source-observations: Exact save observations on the selected branch
messages.plan-source-not-observation: Player-defined schedule · not a save observation
messages.briefing-no-findings-detail: The available snapshot and operational checks did not produce a deterministic warning.
messages.briefing-finding-partial-detail: Some expected source fields were unavailable or rejected in this observation.
messages.briefing-finding-mapping-change-detail: Treat the displayed changes cautiously because the two observations were interpreted under different resolved profiles.
messages.briefing-finding-no-prior-title: No preceding branch observation is available
messages.briefing-finding-recorder-queue-detail:
{ $count ->
    [one] 1 observation is waiting.
   *[other] { $count } observations are waiting.
}
messages.briefing-finding-warehouse-attention-det:
{ $count ->
    [one] 1 warehouse projection has failed.
   *[other] { $count } warehouse projections have failed.
}
messages.briefing-finding-warehouse-lag-detail:
{ $count ->
    [one] 1 warehouse job is pending.
   *[other] { $count } warehouse jobs are pending.
}
messages.briefing-dispatch-observation-ready: The selected observation is complete enough for the current Republic Brief. Review the three evidence assays, then use the specialist workspaces for deeper investigation.
messages.briefing-dispatch-no-observation: No republic claims can be made until an observation is selected. Connect a save directory or inspect an immutable observation in Archive.
messages.briefing-dispatch-player-mapping: A local compatibility profile contributes to this interpretation. The mapped facts are visible and usable, with their player-mapped identity retained.
messages.briefing-dispatch-mapping-change: The comparison crosses a compatibility-profile change. Inspect provenance before treating the numerical differences as like-for-like movement.
messages.briefing-dispatch-no-prior: The selected save provides a current snapshot, but no proven preceding observation exists for movement calculations.
messages.briefing-dispatch-recorder-attention: Save evidence is preserved, but the recorder has conditions requiring attention. Open Monitor for the bounded diagnostic ledger.
messages.briefing-dispatch-recorder-queue: New observations are waiting to be processed. The selected analytical head remains immutable while the queue advances.
messages.briefing-dispatch-warehouse-attention: SQLite-backed save evidence remains available, but analytical warehouse failures require attention before definition-backed models can be trusted.
messages.briefing-dispatch-warehouse-lag: The analytical warehouse is behind the operational record. Save-backed counts remain current; warehouse-dependent results may lag.
messages.chart-summary-gap-count:
{ $count ->
  [one] 1 marked observation gap.
 *[other] { $count } marked observation gaps.
}
messages.production-route-description: Select a catalogued recipe and scale its recorded input and output coefficients around one chosen output. Ribbons use only the target output's comparable basis; other requirements remain visible separately.
messages.production-route-synthetic-note: The desktop catalogue is unavailable in this preview, so the established synthetic steel-allocation proof remains below. Configure the game directory in the desktop application to inspect source-backed recipes.
messages.production-route-unavailable-note: Configure the game directory and publish a definition catalogue to inspect source-backed recipes. Ordinary application mode does not substitute an example material flow.
messages.production-route-status-too-complex: Too many relations for a bounded diagram
messages.production-route-boundary: These are theoretical definition coefficients, not observed throughput, rated capacity, inventory movement, or a mass-balance claim.
messages.production-route-chart-description: Which recorded inputs and outputs accompany a target coefficient of { $target } { $unit } for { $route }? Ribbon width is proportional only within this compatible definition basis.
messages.production-route-chart-takeaway: The largest recorded input coefficient at this target is { $resource }: { $quantity } { $unit }.
messages.production-route-chart-takeaway-none: No comparable input coefficient is available for this route.
messages.production-pathway-boundary: The pathway propagates recorded definition coefficients only when units match exactly. It does not claim observed throughput, capacity, construction feasibility, transport availability, or optimality.
messages.production-pathway-inactive: Build a bounded upstream pathway from the selected production route when you want to inspect its material dependencies.
messages.production-pathway-chart-takeaway-none: Every comparable input in this bounded view has a selected upstream route.
messages.production-pathway-chart-unavailable: The exact pathway ledger remains available, but these relations do not form a valid bounded Sankey diagram.
messages.production-pathway-reason-unsupported-ro: The candidate route lacks a complete comparable coefficient basis.
messages.production-pathway-reason-candidate-limi: Too many candidate routes were found for bounded inspection.
messages.production-pathway-reason-node-limit: The bounded pathway node limit was reached.
messages.production-pathway-reason-link-limit: The bounded pathway link limit was reached.
messages.production-pathway-reason-different-unit: Kept separate because its coefficient basis differs from the stage output.
messages.production-pathway-reason-missing-unit: Kept separate because no verified coefficient basis is recorded.
messages.chart-plan-description: Cumulative, target-normalised progress. The preview shows how actual observations remain separate from the scheduled path.
messages.broadcast-no-receiver-title: No receiver evidence at this analytical head
messages.broadcast-influence-boundary-detail: No calibrated coefficient model exists. Republic Observatory will not invent linear effects for loyalty, education, culture, happiness, addiction, criminality, or religion.
messages.broadcast-notebook-empty-detail: A native, branch-aware intervention ledger is not implemented in this slice. The previous example experiments have been removed from ordinary application mode.
messages.broadcast-bulletin-unavailable-body: No receiver-class observation is selected, so the Broadcast Desk has no numerical claim to publish.
messages.broadcast-station-telemetry-detail: Staffing, rating, availability, reach, and current audience are left unavailable because no bounded source contract supports them.
messages.causality-bulletin-body: Television is the largest receiver class in this synthetic observation, while radio still accounts for one quarter of classified citizens. The illustrated education and propaganda schedule coincides with a gradual loyalty rise, but the Ministry declines to award the transmitter a medal until decoded audience evidence and a longer comparison window arrive.
messages.chart-receiver-description: Synthetic 100% composition of citizens classified as having no receiver, radio, television, or computer. The denominator is the four recorded classes, not total population.
messages.evidence-chart-receiver-description: Observed 100% composition of citizens classified as having no receiver, radio, television, or computer. Records use their actual in-game dates; the denominator is the four recorded classes, not total population.
messages.chart-influence-description: Signed, illustrative effect directions for the selected programming formulation. These are neither calibrated game coefficients nor causal findings.
messages.synthetic-source-outcomes: Synthetic aligned status observations and player annotation
messages.security-extension-host-boundary: The host supplies trusted observations, calculations, provenance, and rendering. Packs describe what they need; they do not bring their own little web browser.
messages.extension-permission-host-resolves-chart: Host resolves observations, evidence, colours, motion, and chart options.
messages.security-model-plugin-boundary: Reserved for a demonstrated statistical model that exceeds the declarative operation catalogue. Any future program runs out of process and receives bounded normalised observations—not saves, binaries, SQLite, parser internals, paths, or rendering access.
messages.extensions-validator-description: The Rust host is the authoritative validator. Ajv independently proves development conformance and keeps examples honest.
messages.extensions-boundary-note: Analysis Packs receive only host-owned normalised observations. Importing a pack does not enable it.
messages.extensions-enabled-notice: { $name } is now enabled for the selected observation branch.
messages.extensions-analysis-description: The host evaluates each enabled pack against the selected branch without joining branches or filling unavailable observations.
messages.extensions-authoritative-validator: The Rust desktop host is the authoritative validator and evaluator. Development schema tests independently keep the public examples conformant.
messages.extensions-enable-description-live: Enabling selects one immutable revision and permits only its declared host-evaluated calculations and chart templates.
messages.catalogue-boundary-note: The host exposes bounded facts and dossiers. Interface code never receives SQL, database paths, or complete installed definition files.
messages.catalogue-heading-description: Source-qualified installed definitions, effective planning values, and reproducible warehouse generations.
messages.catalogue-recorder-independent: Save recording remains available if this analytical warehouse needs attention.
messages.catalogue-auto-cost-warning: Automatic construction coefficients remain unresolved rules until the game's conversion is verified; they are never displayed as final material quantities.
messages.compatibility-change-note: A mapping change creates a new immutable interpretation; it never rewrites an earlier observation.
messages.reinterpretation-failed-note: The existing observation remains available; inspect Diagnostics before trying again.
messages.population-heading-description: Compare exact save snapshots on the selected branch without joining later history, interpolating missing observations, or upgrading source counters into unverified rates.
messages.population-no-observations-detail: The parser has not stored a republic snapshot for the selected analytical context.
messages.population-direct-source-count: Direct source count at the exact selected observation.
messages.population-no-rate-denominator: No rate is inferred because a validated exposure denominator is unavailable.
messages.population-gate-record-layout-detail: A bounded fixed-width candidate table and name-token fields were observed, but the full record contract is not validated.
messages.population-head-exact-note: All charts and city facts stop at this analytical head. Later states on the branch are excluded during historical preview.
messages.population-boundary-no-interpolation: Missing observations are never silently interpolated.
messages.population-chart-education-description: All recorded citizens in the exact selected save, not the game's workers-only education panel. The categories are not normalised into shares without a validated denominator contract.
messages.population-chart-city-description: Direct movement-counter values for one numeric city source at the exact analytical head.
messages.error-observer-invalid-compatibility: The compatibility profile is invalid. The last valid mapping remains active.
messages.error-observer-critical-task-busy: A save reinterpretation is already running.
messages.error-observer-warehouse-write-limit: The analytical workload exceeded its safe warehouse write limit. Save recording remains available; inspect Diagnostics for details.
messages.research-setup-entry-cue-detail: Prepare the optional read-only Tesmio research probe through a bounded, locally validated assistant.
messages.research-setup-checkout-detail: Choose an existing checkout or download the pinned revision. The host validates exact SHA-256 identities for every required build source.
messages.research-setup-build-success: The probe was built and its bounded artifact identity was verified.
messages.research-setup-artifact-unrecorded: A DLL is present from an earlier or manual build, but this assistant has not recorded it as a verified result. Build again to establish its provenance.
messages.research-setup-failure-compile: The fixed C++ build recipe returned an unsuccessful result. Its bounded, path-redacted output is available below and in Diagnostics.
messages.legal-local-data-detail: Observed saves, settings, catalogues, and analytical databases remain on this computer. The application has no required network service and does not encrypt its current non-credential data stores.
messages.markets-desktop-required: The desktop host is required for market evidence
messages.observer-browser-detail: The browser preview keeps synthetic data. Launch the desktop program to choose local folders and observe a save.
messages.monitor-branch-watch-note: { $unresolved } unresolved states remain outside analytical branches.
messages.briefing-finding-unknown-detail: The host returned finding code { $code }. Update Republic Observatory before interpreting it.
messages.briefing-dispatch-unknown: The host returned an unfamiliar dispatch condition. Inspect Diagnostics before interpreting it.
messages.research-setup-build-detail: The host runs one fixed repository build recipe, bounds its output, redacts private paths from the log, and records the resulting content hash.
messages.legal-loader-configuration-detail: Verified observation-only mode revalidates the restricted TesmioLoader configuration and sole-plugin rule before every ingestion. Player-managed modded mode validates Observatory's own probe contract and telemetry only; it cannot certify other plugins or the complete process.
messages.chart-material-flow-takeaway: Domestic output supplies most of the illustrative demand, while imports support the shared pool and 6 units remain explicitly unaccounted rather than being labelled as waste or loss.
messages.broadcast-evidence-desk-detail: This workspace displays recorded receiver facts and explicit research boundaries. It no longer fills unsupported broadcast panels with illustrative values.
messages.broadcast-audience-unavailable-detail: Supported saves expose receiver ownership, not verified station reach, active listeners, or active viewers. The optional binary research track may test this boundary without changing saves.
messages.broadcast-programme-mix-boundary-detail: No validated save or station contract currently exposes the six intended-influence allocations at the selected head.
messages.broadcast-outcomes-unavailable-detail: Citizen outcomes can be observed elsewhere, but this workspace cannot attribute them to radio or television without verified interventions, exposure, lags, and comparison windows.
messages.broadcast-bulletin-evidence-body: The selected save classifies { $count } citizens across no receiver, radio, television, and computer. This is ownership evidence—not proof of reach, listening, viewing, or broadcast influence.
messages.broadcast-heading-description: Treat radio and television as measurable public institutions—without mistaking a handsome correlation for a confession.
messages.catalogue-setup-description: The catalogue will discover local base-game, DLC, Workshop, and WIP definitions without uploading or copying game assets.
messages.catalogue-repair-unavailable: Repair and maintenance planning is unavailable because no explicit source field or verified rule was found for this definition.
messages.catalogue-overlay-description: Profiles preserve installed facts and add explicit player assumptions with reasons and revision preconditions.
messages.catalogue-valid-overlay: Valid inert overlay. Import remains separate from activation.
messages.compatibility-no-editor: Edit the JSON file with your preferred text editor. It cannot contain scripts, SQL, paths, URLs, expressions, callbacks, or rendering options.
